name: OrgChart
label: Org chart
description: Who reports to whom: each person a card with their avatar, name and role, their reports in a row beneath.

props.name: root
props.description: The person at the top, with everyone under them.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's name, read before the people in it ("Design team").

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the people's links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`,
so they navigate through the app's router; a plain `<a>` when unset.
This component can render on the server, so it never reads a
LinkProvider: pass the prop even under one.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

OrgChartNode.description: One person in the chart, and the people who report to them.

keys.note: Each person whose name links to a profile is a native link, reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: TreeView
alternatives.when: the hierarchy is a list to navigate and fold rather than people drawn as a chart
